description: Offline teacher labels (Clef on Cloudflare Workers AI), used to choose and stratify what people label. Training-only: never used to calibrate, threshold or certify anything. Keys are sha256 of [model, questions, prompt text truncated to 8,000 characters]; values are the probability of 'yes' per question. No prompt text is stored.
dataset: lmsys/toxic-chat version 0124, English-only prompts (train and test files); Banking77 (PolyAI, train and test files)
license: Derived from the datasets above, not covered by this repository's MIT licence: the clef-toxicchat-* files follow ToxicChat's CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial use only); clef-banking77-clef.json follows Banking77's CC BY 4.0 (attribution: Casanueva et al., 2020).
questions: src/teacher/questions.ts (TOXICCHAT_QUESTIONS, BANKING77_QUESTIONS); changing their wording changes every key
regenerate: node --import tsx src/teacher/toxicchat-clef.ts [--model clef]; node --import tsx src/teacher/banking77-clef.ts  (reuse these files; only missing texts are sent)
